contracts: Existing OpenNLP 2.4 APIs, WordpieceTokenizer, model serialization, scanner whitespace and keepNewLines behavior remain authoritative.
M3Tokenizers.simpleSpans accepts a stable UTF-16 CharSequence and returns Span[] without calling source.toString or source.subSequence.
WordpieceEncoder.encode(CharSequence) snapshots exactly once with toString; encodeImmutableView trusts caller-stable UTF-16 source for the call.
WordPiece record IDs, normalized spellings and UTF-16 source offsets are preserved across split surrogate pairs.
MappedText mutable normalization buffers remain permitted algorithm scratch, never canonical M3String storage.
M3Tokenizers preserves null-before-cancellation order, host checkpoint identity and interruption flag.
No newer OpenNLP dependency expansion, alternate M3String/M3File/M3AST class, public String rename or Synexia runtime service is introduced.

reused_legacy_atom.decision: The complete method body is identical between vendored 2.4 and pinned fork 3.0. Keep the existing source; do not import newer whitespace modes or unrelated StringUtil APIs.
